<b>Scrollreaders</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are gilded [[Keepers|servants]] of the [[Whispering Vaults]] who were born to read and recall scrolls of prayer.<ref>Scrollreader [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Gilded servant of the Whispering Vaults, born to read and recall the near endless scrolls of prayer."</i></ref> The [[Vaultborn]] are their juvenile form.<ref>[[Vaultborn]] Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Young acolyte raised in the darkest vaults, destined to ascend to the rank of Scrollreader."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Scrollreaders are often found sitting in place reading or are dead on the floor and get reanimated by silk, but grab their weapon and begin battle once Hornet comes near. Scrollreaders have 4 different attacks and moves they can perform, and walk towards Hornet to pursue her if she gets out of attack range:
* <b>Thrust:</b> Holds its weapon horizontally behind itself for a moment before thrusting it forwards.
* <b>Double Swing:</b> Holds its weapon vertically behind itself for a moment, then slashes outwards twice.
* <b>Crashing Leap:</b> Jumps up, hovering for a moment, before launching itself at Hornet, taking a brief moment to recover once it lands.
* <b>Retreat:</b> Scuttles backwards to avoid strikes, often used after missing a move – especially Crashing Leap – and if Hornet is close to it.

Scrollreaders deal {{Damage|2}} for all attacks as well as contact damage.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Scrollreaders have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Creation and Development ==
[[File:Enemy 163 164 165.png|thumb|220px|First reveal image]]
Scrollreaders, alongside [[Lampbearer]]s and [[Vaultkeeper]]s, were first revealed in a blog post released in December 2019, where their sprite was shown. [[Team Cherry]] described them as being in a <i>"tough later game trio who, when in battle, work closely together, covering for each other's weaknesses."</i><ref>[https://www.teamcherry.com.au/blog/11xf7azcuebhybgossfhdc0mphiqbs Team Cherry blog post] of December 13th, 2019</ref> 

In the final build, these three enemies do not specifically work together, and thus do not cover for each other's weaknesses.

Scrollreaders were also originally planned to be able to block attacks from Hornet.<ref>[[:File:Scrollreader Cut Sprites.png|Scrollreader Cut Sprites]]</ref>
